nom: IT Cosmetics Confidence in an Eye Cream Anti-Aging Peptide Eye Cream

avis.texte: After having done a lot of research, I really wanted to like this eye cream . It was delivered very quickly, the product was very smooth and unscented. However, it did irritate and redden my eyes. Unfortunately, I had to return it - I guess this product was just not right for my skin.

avis.titre: IT cosmetics confidence in an eye Peptide
avis.texte: Another product I've been using for years: goes on smoothly, feels like it works best overnight. I wake up with refreshed eyes, and best of all, it can be used on both lower and upper lids

avis.titre: Big promises, disappointing outcome. Not for me.
avis.texte: Rich and hydrating, but not for me. The cream feels too greasy on my eyes (upper and lower), comes in a very small amount, and the high price doesn't match the experience or the outcome. I wanted to love it, purchased it 3 times, have to give up.
Really helps the fine lines around my eyes. Just looks so much better after a short time using.
Used this each night for about a week and developed dry rash on my eye lids. Didn't feel like it helped or had any benefit otherwise. Keep looking.

avis.titre: I have been using for years.
avis.texte: This is my favorite eye cream. I am sensitive to a lot of products, but I can wear this. I cannot use the face cream unfortunately.

I've been using this eye cream for at least 3 months now, & I haven't noticed any improvements. I have dark circles under my eyes that I thought would lighten some, but sadly they have not. I wouldn't necessarily say the skin feels any firmer/tighter either. I don't have any eye wrinkles so I can't speak on whether it helps with that. For the price, I expected much better results.

avis.titre: Best eye cream that I have used
avis.texte: This is the best eye cream that I have used. I have super sensitive skin and usually everytime I try an eye cream it either doesn't work like it is supposed to or makes my eyes water all day. With IT Confidence in an eye cream, my eyes don't water, the dark circles are visibly lighter and around my eyes are moisturized and the lines are lighter. I will absolutely buy again.

I have been using this for over 6 months now.i love how it goes on, you do not need to much. It just absorbs into your skin. I can see that the lines under and around my eyes are starting so go away. This is part of my daily routine along with other IT beauty products. Just turning 50 taking my skin regimen seriously, and this is part of it.
This cream dries out the skin around my eyes during the day causing a dry layer around the eyes which is not pretty. I do not feel any benefit in using this cream. I would not go back to buy again.

I really wanted to like this sm I think IT is a good brand but this irritated my eyes the first night I tried this. I put it on for one or two more nights to make sure it was this and not something else, and it was definitely this. I do have some skin sensitivities but nothing major. So if you have sensitive skin I'd avoid

I entered my 40s and noticed that I was starting to get hooded eyelids. I read a lot of reviews and chose this cream. It *does* burn a little when you start using it, which tells you something is happening. I use it in the AM to perk up my eyes
It did absolutely nothing for me and when I used it at night and applied make up the next day it would be very patchy under my eyes.
It did absolutely nothing for me and when I used it at night and applied make up the next day it would be very patchy under my eyes.
tried this product and the instant it went on it burned and irritated my skin. I had to wash it off immediately. do not recommend for sensitive skin.

Used to love this profict. But started using it and within hours my skin was red, inflammed and hot to the touch. Thought it might of been my sunscreen or facewash. But nope… it was this. Shame. It was perfect. Wish they wouldn't of messed with the formula becuae its a nope for me if you have sensitive skin.

This cream is really great. It has lightened my under eye area dramatically, so those with darkness would definitely benefit. I actually didn't get this thinking it would lighten my eye area, but was pleasantly surprised. It's very hydrating and helps fine lines.
I'm new to buying eye creams and they can get pretty pricey. I had just a sampler version, I really enjoyed it. I have oily skin but it moisturized nicely and had creamy texture.

I was excited to try this. I was trying to find a replacement for Glamglow BrightEyes eye cream. It burns the skin under my eyes and as the day goes on it gets into the eye and irritates it too. I bought this as part of a set.

I have dark circles because of genetics and this product does help a little, i dont ever expect any product to take my dark circles away completely but my eyes do feel moisturized and my skin is not so loose and wrinkley. I have sensitive skin and this product does not cause me irritation.

I received a sample size over a year ago, added it to my skin care routine at night. Woke up with itchy, irritated eyes after the first night so I threw it away. However, last month I purchased an IT Confidence gift set that contained the moisturizer (which I love), Cleanser, and eye cream. I decided to try the eye cream again, thinking it had been over a year so maybe the formula was improved.....wrong! I decided to try the eye cream and within hours my eyes are irritated, swollen, and itchy. I avoided getting too close to my eye lids, focusing on lower underlying, but it still managed to irritate my eyes! Don't even take a chance to see if you're one of the few who wouldn't react to this. Find another eye cream and save the money. I'm just glad I basically got it free in a gift set, or else I'd return it.

Please heed the warnings of the others. I did not because I dont have sensitive skin and have never had an issue with an eye cream. I only used the cream twice. The first time I didn't notice an issue but woke up the next morning with crusty eyes. I didnt think much of it and put a small amount on that morning. Almost instantly my skin under my eyes started burning. I developed swelling and red blotchy patches under my eyes where I applied the cream. Will definitely be returning.

I, like many, thought this would be an amazing peptide cream! And while it does work pretty well alone, I DO NOT recommend wearing this under makeup or with makeup. Don't out concealer over it or mix it with any makeup. Forget the makeup tips, they do not work. Just west it alone on a no makeup day or a day you are not wearing any makeup. Other than that, its a decent product.

the product works. I do see a noticeable difference within a half hour of putting this under my eyes. However, something about this makes my eyes slightly itchy. No redness or anything for me thankfully.

avis.titre: i would NOT buy this product again.
avis.texte: Unfortunately, after several days of using this product, I broke out in a rash on my face. I immediately returned the product and was given a full refund. I have sensitive skin and sometimes have issues with various skin products....unfortunately, the issue sometimes doesn't show up for a few days. If you don't have sensitive skin, this product may work for you. If you do have sensitive skin, I'd try something else.

I was excited to try a new eye cream by It cosmetics! Unfortunately I did start experiencing contact dermatis on my eye lids and under eye area, where I would have a temporary rash occur multiple times throughout the day. I had to discontinue use of this product. In the time I did use the product, I did notice a reduction in under eye bags and signs of fatigue. I would recommend a patch test prior to the use of this product, before incorporating it fully into your daily skincare routine. I'd imagine others may experience sensitivity to the products ingredients.

This is the only way I can use retinol in the winter without major chaffing and a constant uncomfortable itch. I stray because I'm curious and enticed by beautiful packaging but I always come right back. This blurs lines and quenches without risking breakouts.

avis.titre: I always buy this product. My one & only product!
avis.texte: At 85 years old, I find this is the best product I have ever used. I like it when people tell me I don"t look my age.

The IT Cosmetics Confidence in an Eye Cream has definitely landed on my yuck list. Initially I felt it did a good job of hydrating my eye area, however, over time I've noticed an itching/burning sensation after application. I've also noticed that my eye area feels dry throughout the day. Additionally, if I don't prime my eyelids after application, my eyeshadow sticks in spots and clumps up. Would not purchase again.

The only thing it does is hydrate, but it doesnt last long. I have mast cell disorder, so I am more sensitive than most people, but not all products sting and bother my eyes and this does. Coming from a company founded by someone with skin issues, I would have expected more. Its not super expensive, but it also costs more than it should in my opinion.

This is by far the best eye cream I have ever used. The results are quick and last overnight because when I wake up in the morning, the area under my eyes looks smooth. After I wash my face again and reapply it, the results last throughout the day.

I dont know whats happened to the It's cosmetics line but has definitely changed for the worst , i put this on and instantly my skin was burning and my eyes became red and irritated, in less than 15 minutes my eye area was red , blotchy, burning , and swollen pluss sooo dehydrating , even after I washed my face and rinced with cold water had irritated eyes for 3 days , terrible, this is a very delicate area , this product is dangerous ! So obviously i had to return it , i have used almost every product from the IT line ,but after this i think its time to find a new brand , something has definitely changed with there products : (
Picked up a second jar with the last sale. Formula changed?! Burns and made my under eyes incredibly dry. Aged my eyes with make up. So disappointed.
I don't know what the difference is between the large size and the small size. I have never had an issue with the small size, but I will have to return this product.

This was nice for about 3 day..then it started to leave my eyes red, splotchy, burnt, itchy, and swollen. I believe this gave me contact dermatitis that I am now struggling through. Don't recommend. Very upset.. :(

I got a sample in a mystery bag and was so excited to try it. three texture felt great and I used it in my night routine. I woke up the next morning and my under eyes were red and splotchy. I was really disappointed and tossed it. This may not be for someone without mature skin. I'm glad it was a sample and I didn't waste a ton of money!
This completely burned my undereyes and around. Dried the skin and had just a harsh reaction. Ive never had a priduct react like this thst cost this much

avis.titre: Sensitive Eyes? Puffy Eyes? Sick of hunting?  TRY THIS!
avis.texte: While I buy A LOT of skin care and makeup, I don't typically write many reviews. This product must be shared though. I have struggled finding an eye cream that actually works and is good for my sensitive eyelids. I have tried them all. Super expensive to drug store with zero luck. I would wake up in the morning with my eyelids red and nearly touching my eyebrows they were so swollen (it's not a good look BTW....). If I found something that didn't irritate my eyes, it also did nothing. Nada. Zip. This is IT (pun intended). Seriously, one application and overnight my eyes went from hooded to "hello", red to calm and super moisturized. ONE APPLICATION. 10 out of 10. I honestly cannot gush about this product enough. I will forever have this eye cream in my cabinet.
Looks fine on my wrinkles but it irritates my eyes really bad. I got dry and itchy eyes after every application.
This is the best eye cream I've ever used. I've used it for 3 years now.
Love it, non greasy. I've tried several other brands and this is my favorite
I love everything I have got from IT. Feels wonderful when applying it.
This eye cream has left burns around my eyes and then it peels. When I use it, I wake up in the morning with red burn marks and itching around my eyes.
Best eye cream I ever tried. Just the right amount of hydration without being oily
This is the very best eye cream. It is very light and a little goes a long way.

I've been using this for a few months now & cannot see any improvements. If anything I'm struggling with how sticky it is on my skin. It's a first fir an eye cream however. Unfortunately I'm not happy with the new formula.
Visible difference in two weeks!! I will be purchasing again.

I used this cream for a few months, and was happy with it at first. It goes on super smooth, and I mainly used it at night. But I started to notice that if I wore it during the day it didn't play very nice with my makeup (clumping), and I eventually noticed skin peeling on my upper lids. Maybe my eyelid skin is sensitive? Discontinued use at that point. Maybe I will try just applying to below the eye area.
I love the eye cream. I can definitely see a difference when I use it.
I really like the texture of Confidence in an Eye Cream. It works on my fine lines, sinks into my skin, and doesn't feel greasy at all. I can even put my concealer on after using it.
The skin around my eyes feels so much better after using this product
Not great. Definitely disappointed. Impulse buy that I regret
I cannot be without this product. If I use anything else my makeup cakes up in my fine lines. This helps smooth those likes so my makeup stays smooth and even
Absolute love it. I had used other products but nothing compares, I won't use anything else.

avis.titre: The product is so good on my skin I have eczema it works.
avis.texte: I just love this skin care line. My husband notices how good my skin looks. This skin care is for anyone with any skin issues. So glad they created all their skin care. I have been using this skin care line for over a year. I have good skin color even without makeup.

avis.titre: Best eye cream for a reasonable price
avis.texte: Small amount of cream goes a long way. Since I am older I appreciate how easily it glides on my fragile skin.
Best eye cream on the market! I've tried many and this is hands down the best
The texture of this cream is a little on the thick side, but feels so rich and buttery on the skin. It goes on so smooth and absorbs well without feeling heavy or sticky.

I have used this eye cream for years and have loved it, but the new formula now burns my eye lids. It causes my eyelids and skin under my eyes to burn and then peel. It took me a while to determine what was causing it. I couldn't understand why my eyes were so dry, burning and peeling. When I saw that the formula had changed, I then thought it might be my eye cream. I quit using it and my eyes are finally back to normal. Please go back to the old formula. .i am having to buy a different brand and missing my original formula.

I have been using Dr Dennis gross products for a long time and his under eye products weren't helping enough with the dryness. I heard good things about confidence and thought I'd try it. My first application felt sooo luxurious. It was everything I was hoping for. Then about 10 minutes later my eyes were burning so bad I couldn't wash my eyes fast enough. I thought maybe I put too much on. So next night I tried again and same thing happened. I cannot use this. I don't understand especially when it says it's formulated with the help of a dermatologist. Doesn't make any sense. I don't have particularly sensitive skin. I'm very bummed that I paid so much and I can't use it. I gave 3 stars because it really does feel luxurious. Disappointed nonetheless.

avis.titre: Product is fine, but reward program is terrible
avis.texte: Overall, I like the products, however, I am so annoyed with this company's products of offers. It's so expensive. It's hard to even budget the cost over what it is worth. I ordered four products on the buy one get one offer. As I had a lot in my cart, I was supposed to get all of the free samples that went with it. However, I only received the products and zero samples, it's probably because I used some of my reward dollars, which I would've thought were counted as dollars. Those incentives are supposed to get to buy more, but I won't be doing that in the future.
I love the texture. Not sure if it works yet. But so far I really like it.
it feels nice on the skin ive used for a few days and noticed my eyes feeling a burning sensation everytime i put it around my eyes. Will be returning /:
Plumps my eyes, feels so good on my skin. Can't wear my concealer without it!
Me gusta que la crema no deja el oko grasoso. Deja una sensación de comodidad.

avis.titre: Never weeps into eyes-it stays put!
avis.texte: It is the only eye cream that does not weep into my eyes causing intolerable burning and tears. I have given this as a gift to several and they are now loyal customers, too. If you want a great and effective eye cream, look no further. You have found it!
I love this eye cream. It's rich, creamy texture & subtle tone work well to smooth lines & conceal undereye coloring. I have minimal discoloration & it works great for me.
This product makes a unbelievable difference in your skin… I use it every night underneath the beauty mask and in less than ttwo werks my skin is glowing…I highly recommend this product…

Great stuff!! I can tell immediately if I didn't use this product..undereye is less firm looking and dries out eventually but when I do makes stays looking smoother and less visible creases for sure! Amazing!
I do not like it at all! It is such a heavy cream and feels like I have a residue on my face instead of it feeling smooth.
You really feel as soon as you put it on that it is doing you good my bags have definitely reduced and the dark circles also

avis.titre: Confidence in a Cream Anti-Aging Hydrating
avis.texte: feels wonderful, no more dry eye area. Cannot wait to see how it changes the skin appearance.
This is my favorite under eye cream I've ever used. It really works to smooth out wrinkles.

I bought this eyecream a while ago for fine lines and hydration and it made my eye area burn. I gave it to my partner and a few months later i needed an eyecream. I saw he still had this one and I started using it again and it is irritating my eyes and causing itchy pimples. Its also making me have wrinkles in the inside corners of my eye, maybe due to irritation? Do not use if you have a senstive eye area.
I use this AM and PM and can see a significant difference in fine lines.

Still waiting for the great results promised. It is nice consistency but so are a couple of other brands I have used. I am on my third jar. Not sure if there really is a difference yet but I like other IT products so I figured why not.
Really its perfect eye cream, its most effective and perfect complement for me
This is the best eye-cream I have ever used - it is very moisturizing and also has visibly reduced wrinkles from my under eyes.
This is my favorite eye cream of all time. It is so soothing when I apply it, and I can instantly feel it working and see the results.
I love this stuff. Luckily I don't feel I really NEED an eye cream yet but I'm using it to slow and prevent aging and I love it so far!
I like this product a lot. I like the two types of cream. They were soothing for my eyes
Best eye cream ever. REduces puffiness and dark circles while providing light moisture

avis.titre: Mos Hydrating Eye cream I've Tried
avis.texte: I tend to have dry skin, including under my eyes, and therefore stated seeing fine lines. This is the only eye cream that is rich enough to hydrate, yet even when I use it in the morning it doesn't cause any of my makeup to bot or smudge. My IT concealer blends beautifully over it. My fine lines are greatly diminished
I saw a big difference after using this cream. The skin around my eyes is much more hydrated and much firmer after using this cream. Worst every cent!
Love the ingredients and texture! Great eye cream for day to night and great under makeup!
The citrus smell is addictive. The creaminess and gentleness of the cleanser never leaves my face feeling stripped of oil.
They put fragrance in their eye and face creams. Why?? It's so bad for skin, and irritating
It tightens up your under eye & eyelids. Makes your eyes look opened, & larger.
Have used this product for many years. It does a fantastic job!

This is by far the best under eye cream I've ever used!! It's so rich and creamy and makes my under eyes look brighter instantly! It's perfect under make up too..doesn't dry out or give that greasy appearance that melts make up off with some products!! Permanently added to my skincare routine!! :)
Love this eye cream. Have tried several different creams and always come back to this one. Moisturizes under eye and goes well under makeup without looking cakey.

avis.titre: feels good, is gentle w/o scent, love it.
avis.texte: One of my favorites. I rub my eyes due to allergies. I know I shouldnt but it happens. I also have dry skin, and the rubbing doesnt help the fine lines. I love this stuff! No scent to trigger allergies and feels SO good to the dry skin on my eyes.
This eye cream made my makeup cake horribly, even after I allowed it is soak in a bit. My eye area was flaky and dry looking, so frustrating.
Used it for over a couple of weeks never had anything more hydrating

This eye cream is so moisturizing and I love that I can use it on the upper lid as well as underneath the eye. The skin around my eyes is very sensitive plus I've a ton of allergies and I've never had ANY problems with it and have been using it since it was first introduced years ago. My 72 year old eyes look great and I've recommended it to lots of women and given it as gifts to close friends.
This jar is large, it will last ages. I feel that this has really brightened, tightened and hydrated my eye area. Fantastic company and I def recommend this product
When I use this eye cream my concealer goes on so smoothly. Does not crack or anything like that.
I love this eye cream. It goes on smooth. Not greasy and just feels refreshing.
Definitely is my go-to for an eye cream and is used twice daily. Consistency is perfect. Not heavy and absorbs well
This product was not efective for puffiness or under eye circles for me. It was okay to have under makeup.
I've tried other brands at times and I always come back to this one. It leaves my skin soft and hydrated and does not break me out. It is worth the higher price point.

avis.titre: It absorbs nicely around my eyes.
avis.texte: Love this eye cream. It absorbs nicely around my eyes without leaving any residue.

avis.titre: Love the moisture the eye cream gives
avis.texte: I love the feel of the softness and moisture it makes my eye area feel
